name: Burlington

queries.query: Burlington Ontario official parcel map GIS property boundaries
queries.result: First-party City of Burlington maps/open-data pages identify Navigate Burlington and a public parcel-information map route. The linked legacy MapXpress viewer was identified, but its HTML request timed out during the bounded direct request. Ontario's first-party open-data catalog also exposes a public lot-fabric service covering Ontario.

queries.query: Burlington Ontario carte parcelles cadastrales carte interactive officielle
queries.result: No separate Burlington French-language municipal parcel viewer was found. The bilingual/federal Canadian Land Survey System map and Ontario government parcel-data discovery were identified; the Ontario first-party lot-fabric endpoint returned a bounded parcel geometry for the exact WUP point.

registryEvidence: The City of Burlington's official maps/open-data pages establish the municipal GIS custodian and link public map/open-data services. Ontario's official LIO open-data service is a provincial parcel/lot-fabric custodian and returned a bounded polygon for the exact point. This is source evidence, not runtime adapter admission.

source.name: Ontario LIO Open Data - Lot Fabric Improved

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official City page identified Navigate Burlington as the municipal GIS map/open-data entry point; no parcel geometry was directly returned by this page request.
TLS-verified request timed out after 30 seconds. No inference of absence was made; no login, bypass, or certificate exception was attempted.

Anonymous TLS-verified metadata request succeeded. Polygon layer; source spatial reference EPSG:4269; fields include OGF_ID, LOT_IDENT, CONCESSION_IDENT, GEOGRAPHIC_TOWNSHIP_NAME, and OBJECTID. Unsafe owner/address/contact/title/tax/account fields were not requested.

requestOutcomes.parameters: f=geojson; geometry=-79.7961975166044,43.3652646922607; geometryType=esriGeometryPoint; inSR=4326; spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects; outFields=OGF_ID,LOT_IDENT,CONCESSION_IDENT,GEOGRAPHIC_TOWNSHIP_NAME; returnGeometry=true; outSR=4326
requestOutcomes.outcome: Anonymous request succeeded and returned one polygon intersecting the exact supplied WUP point, with OGF_ID 201051749. Full unchanged response is retained only in ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/burlington/point-query-safe.geojson; no retained sample was written because the packet permits but does not require one.

fieldMapping.OGF_ID: stable native Ontario geographic feature identifier

schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyContext: No composite key required for the bounded hit; OGF_ID was selected as the canonical native identity.

coverageAssessment: The exact point query demonstrates public service reachability and one bounded lot-fabric result only. It does not establish citywide legal cadastral completeness, currentness, or municipal ownership of the provincial layer. The supplied point was used unchanged.
remainingUncertainty: The current Navigate Burlington JavaScript/configuration and any municipal parcel API schema remain unverified because the legacy viewer request timed out. Ontario LIO lot fabric may not equal Burlington's authoritative assessment/title parcel fabric. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, valuation, or certificate fields were requested or retained. Packet completion is research evidence only, not source integration or admission.
